This dataset stores per-example paraphrase predictions for the GLUE MRPC validation set produced by a DistilBERT-based cosine similarity pipeline. For each sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation, the notebook encodes sentence1 and sentence2 with distilbert-base-uncased, applies masked max pooling to the token embeddings, computes the cosine similarity between the two normalized sentence embeddings, and converts that score to a binary prediction using a threshold of 0.85.

Structure:
- prediction: integer binary label predicted by the similarity rule (1 = paraphrase, 0 = not paraphrase)
- cosine_scores: float cosine similarity between the max-pooled embeddings of the two sentences

Each record corresponds to one input sentence pair and is linked back to the source validation examples through input_items. In this workflow, the dataset serves as the main model-output table for downstream evaluation, inspection of correct and incorrect predictions, and creation of the final summary metrics dataset.

This dataset stores per-example paraphrase predictions for the GLUE MRPC validation set produced by this notebook’s embedding-similarity baseline. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and contains two fields: prediction, a binary label (1 if the pair is predicted to be a paraphrase, 0 otherwise), and similarities, the cosine similarity score between the L2-normalized sentence embeddings of sentence1 and sentence2. The embeddings are generated with distilbert-base-uncased by averaging the last 4 hidden layers at the token level and then mean-pooling across tokens. Predictions are created by applying a fixed threshold of 0.85 to the similarity score. In this workflow, this dataset is the intermediate model output used to inspect individual examples, analyze errors, and compute the final evaluation summary in distilbert_last4_mean_cosine_mrpc_summary.

Per-example prediction dataset for the GLUE MRPC validation split. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores the output of a simple paraphrase classifier built from DistilBERT sentence embeddings. The dataset has two fields: prediction, a binary label where 1 means paraphrase and 0 means not paraphrase, produced by thresholding the cosine similarity at 0.85; and score, the raw cosine similarity between the L2-normalized first-token embeddings of sentence1 and sentence2 from distilbert-base-uncased. In this workflow, this dataset is the main record of model inference results, used for error analysis, inspection of individual examples, and as input to the downstream summary dataset distilbert_cls_cosine_mrpc_summary.

Summary dataset for the DistilBERT CLS cosine-similarity evaluation on the GLUE MRPC validation split. It contains aggregate evaluation results computed by comparing thresholded cosine-similarity predictions from sentence-pair embeddings against the ground-truth MRPC labels. The record list has three fields: accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string with per-class precision/recall/F1 and support). In this workflow, it serves as the experiment-level evaluation artifact: a compact summary of model performance derived from the glue_mrpc_validation inputs and the per-example predictions stored in cosine_mrpc_threshold_score.

Summary dataset for the DistilBERT cosine-similarity MRPC validation experiment. It contains an aggregate evaluation record for paraphrase detection on the GLUE MRPC validation split, where sentence1 and sentence2 are encoded with distilbert-base-uncased, the last 4 hidden layers are averaged, mean pooled into sentence embeddings, and classified by cosine similarity using a threshold of 0.85. The dataset structure has 3 fields: accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string with per-class precision/recall/F1 and support). In this workflow, it serves as the final experiment-level metrics table summarizing model performance over the full validation set, with provenance linked to both the source dataset glue_mrpc_validation and the per-example prediction dataset cosine_mrpc_mean_similarity_prediction.

Row-level prediction outputs for the GLUE MRPC validation set produced by the Hugging Face model textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC. Each record corresponds to one input sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores: prediction (final binary class after applying a margin rule), score_pos (softmax score for the paraphrase class), and score_neg (softmax score for the not_paraphrase class). In this workflow, the dataset serves as the persisted model-output table used to trace predictions back to the original validation examples and to support downstream metric computation, error analysis, and experiment summaries.

This dataset stores the experiment-level evaluation summary for the DistilBERT max-pooling cosine-similarity approach on the GLUE MRPC validation set. It contains a single summary record with three fields: accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string). The values are computed by comparing binary paraphrase predictions—generated by thresholding cosine similarity between max-pooled DistilBERT embeddings of sentence pairs—against the ground-truth MRPC labels. In this workflow, the dataset serves as the final aggregated results table for the notebook, capturing overall model performance in a compact form for later inspection, comparison, and lineage tracking back to the validation data and prediction outputs.

distilbert_mean_cosine_median_threshold_mrpc_summary is a summary dataset containing the evaluation results for the DistilBERT mean-pooled cosine-similarity baseline on the GLUE MRPC validation set. It stores aggregate metrics computed after encoding each sentence pair with distilbert-base-uncased, measuring cosine similarity between the two sentence embeddings, and converting scores to binary paraphrase predictions using the median similarity as the decision threshold. The dataset has three fields: accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string with per-class precision/recall/F1 and support). In this workflow, it serves as the final experiment-level output that summarizes model performance over the full validation split, with provenance linked to both the source dataset glue_mrpc_validation and the per-example prediction dataset threshold_cosine_mrpc_similarity_prediction.

Summary dataset for the MRPC validation run using distilbert-base-uncased sentence embeddings. It contains aggregate evaluation results for paraphrase prediction on glue_mrpc_validation, where sentence1 and sentence2 are encoded separately, token embeddings are mean-pooled while excluding special tokens ([CLS], [SEP]), cosine similarity is computed between the two sentence embeddings, and a fixed threshold of 0.85 is used to produce binary paraphrase predictions.

Structure: one record with fields accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string). The record is linked to the full glue_mrpc_validation input range and to the no_special_cosine_mrpc_similarity_prediction dataset that stores per-example predictions and cosine scores.

Role in workflow: this dataset is the experiment-level evaluation summary, used to capture the overall performance of the no-special-token mean-pooled cosine-similarity baseline on MRPC validation.

Per-example prediction outputs for the GLUE MRPC validation set generated with the textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC classifier under two sentence orders. Each record corresponds to one validation example and contains three fields: prediction (final binary label after averaging both orders and thresholding at 0.5), pos_probs (paraphrase probability for the original input order: sentence1, sentence2), and swap_pos_probs (paraphrase probability for the swapped order: sentence2, sentence1). This dataset is the intermediate prediction table used to capture order-sensitive model scores, produce the bidirectional averaged decision, and feed the final evaluation summary.

Summary dataset for the MRPC entailment-logprob-odds experiment on the GLUE MRPC validation split. It contains evaluation results for paraphrase predictions produced from a zero-shot NLI model (typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli), where each sentence pair is scored using the average entailment-vs-contradiction log-odds across both input orders. Structure: one record with columns accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string). Its role in this workflow is to provide a compact experiment-level summary of model performance, derived from the full per-example outputs in mrpc_entailment_prediction and the ground-truth labels in glue_mrpc_validation.

glue_mrpc_validation is the validation split of the GLUE MRPC (Microsoft Research Paraphrase Corpus) dataset stored in TableVault for this notebook. Each record contains sentence1, sentence2, label, and idx, where sentence1 and sentence2 are a pair of sentences, label is a binary paraphrase target (1 = paraphrase, 0 = not paraphrase), and idx is the example identifier from the original dataset. This dataset is the ground-truth evaluation input for the workflow: the sentence pairs are tokenized and passed to the pretrained textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC model, and the labels are used to compute accuracy, F1, error cases, and the final classification report. It serves as the source dataset linked to downstream prediction, mistake-analysis, and summary output records.

Summary dataset for the bidirectional MRPC evaluation run. It contains aggregate evaluation results for the TextAttack DistilBERT MRPC classifier on the GLUE MRPC validation set, where paraphrase probabilities are computed for both the original sentence order and the swapped sentence order, then averaged before thresholding to make the final prediction.

Structure:
- accuracy: float overall classification accuracy on the validation set
- f1: float F1 score for the paraphrase class
- classification_report: string version of the sklearn classification report, including per-class precision, recall, F1, and support

Role in this workflow:
This dataset serves as the experiment-level evaluation summary for the notebook. It records the final performance metrics derived from comparing the averaged bidirectional predictions against the true labels, and links those metrics back to both the source dataset (glue_mrpc_validation) and the per-example prediction dataset (distilbert_swap_prediction_values).

This dataset stores the aggregate evaluation results for the notebook’s MRPC margin-rule experiment. It contains a summary record with three fields: accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string containing the full sklearn classification report, including per-class precision, recall, f1-score, and support for not_paraphrase and paraphrase). The values are computed by comparing the true labels from glue_mrpc_validation against binary predictions produced from the TextAttack DistilBERT MRPC model, where prediction = 1 when score_pos - score_neg exceeds the configured margin threshold. Its role in the workflow is to provide a compact, final performance summary for the full validation set, linked to both the source validation data and the per-example prediction dataset distilbert_margin_score_prediction_values.

This dataset stores the aggregate evaluation summary for the DistilBERT MRPC inference run on the GLUE MRPC validation set after converting pipeline raw logits to softmax probabilities. It contains one summary record with three fields: accuracy (overall prediction accuracy), f1 (binary F1 score for paraphrase detection), and classification_report (the full sklearn text report with per-class precision, recall, F1, support, and overall averages). In this workflow, it serves as the experiment-level performance snapshot, linking the source validation examples and the per-example prediction dataset pipeline_distilbert_softmax_probs so that users can quickly inspect overall model quality without recomputing metrics.

This record list stores the aggregate metrics for hf_pipeline_mrpc_short_maxlen_64, the MRPC validation experiment that runs textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC through a Hugging Face text-classification pipeline with sentence-pair inputs truncated to max_length=64. It contains a single summary record with accuracy, f1, and classification_report from sklearn, computed by comparing the model predictions in pipeline_distilbert_shortened against the labels in glue_mrpc_validation. The table is linked to the full validation input range and the per-example prediction table, so it serves as the compact performance result for comparing the shortened-input pipeline run with the other MRPC variants.

Summary dataset for the hf_pipeline_mrpc_threshold_070 experiment. It contains a single evaluation record aggregating model performance on the full glue_mrpc_validation split after running the Hugging Face text-classification pipeline with textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC and converting paraphrase probabilities to binary predictions using a 0.70 threshold. The dataset has three fields: accuracy (float), f1 (float, for the positive paraphrase class), and classification_report (string produced by sklearn, containing per-class precision, recall, f1-score, support, and overall averages). Its role in the workflow is to provide a compact experiment-level summary derived from the validation labels and the per-example predictions stored in pipeline_distilbert_threshold, so the notebook can track and compare final thresholded evaluation results.

Model prediction outputs for the GLUE MRPC validation set generated by the textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC sequence classification model. Each record corresponds to one sentence-pair example in glue_mrpc_validation and stores the model’s predicted class label for paraphrase detection. The dataset has a single field, prediction, which is an integer class ID (0 = not paraphrase, 1 = paraphrase). In this workflow, it serves as the inference output table linked back to the source validation examples and is used to compute evaluation metrics, compare predictions with ground-truth labels, and identify error cases.

mrpc_entailment_prediction contains per-example prediction outputs for the GLUE MRPC validation set generated with the typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli NLI model. Each record corresponds to one validation pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores three fields: prediction (binary paraphrase decision obtained by thresholding the averaged score at 0), dir12 (entailment-minus-contradiction log-probability score for sentence1 → sentence2), and dir21 (the same score for sentence2 → sentence1). The dataset is aligned one-to-one with the source MRPC examples through input item indexing. Its role in this workflow is to capture the model’s directional entailment-based evidence and final paraphrase prediction for downstream evaluation, error analysis, and summary metric computation.

mrpc_gate_margin_prediction is a per-example prediction dataset derived from the GLUE MRPC validation split. For each validation pair (sentence1, sentence2), the notebook runs the NLI model typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli in both input orders, sentence1→sentence2 and sentence2→sentence1, and stores the resulting decision signals used for paraphrase classification. The dataset has four fields: prediction (final binary paraphrase prediction, 1 for paraphrase and 0 for not paraphrase), margin_12 (entailment logit minus contradiction logit for sentence1 paired with sentence2), margin_21 (the same margin for the reversed order), and gate (boolean flag that is true only when neither direction’s argmax label is contradiction). The final prediction is produced by requiring gate = true and the average of margin_12 and margin_21 to be greater than 0. This dataset serves as the main intermediate output of the workflow: it preserves the model’s directional margin scores and final gated prediction for each MRPC example, and it is then used to compute the summary accuracy, F1, and classification report.

Per-example prediction dataset for the GLUE MRPC validation split, generated by running the sentence pairs through the typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli model in both input orders. Each record corresponds to one MRPC validation example and is linked to the matching row in glue_mrpc_validation. The dataset has three fields: prediction (binary paraphrase decision, where 1 indicates paraphrase and 0 indicates not paraphrase), gap_12 (entailment probability minus contradiction probability for sentence1→sentence2), and gap_21 (the same probability gap for sentence2→sentence1). In this workflow, it serves as the stored per-instance model output used to inspect directional confidence, compare predictions with ground-truth MRPC labels, and build the downstream summary metrics in softmax_gap_mean_mrpc_summary.

mrpc_min_margin_prediction is an example-level prediction dataset derived from the GLUE MRPC validation split. For each sentence pair in glue_mrpc_validation, it stores the binary paraphrase prediction produced by a zero-shot NLI model (typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli) and the confidence score used to make that prediction.

Each record corresponds to one MRPC validation example and has two fields: prediction, an integer label where 1 indicates paraphrase and 0 indicates not_paraphrase; and min_margin, a float equal to the minimum of the entailment-versus-contradiction logit margins computed in both input directions, sentence1→sentence2 and sentence2→sentence1. The prediction is defined as 1 when min_margin > 0, otherwise 0.

In this workflow, this dataset serves as the per-example output of the min-direction-margin inference step. It is used as the input to downstream evaluation and summarization, including accuracy, F1, classification report generation, and error analysis.

Per-example prediction dataset for the GLUE MRPC validation split, produced by applying the typeform/distilbert-base-uncased-mnli model as a zero-shot paraphrase detector. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores: prediction (binary paraphrase decision, where 1 indicates paraphrase and 0 indicates not_paraphrase), score_12 (entailment logit minus max(contradiction, neutral) for sentence1 -> sentence2), and score_21 (the same score for sentence2 -> sentence1). The final prediction is derived from the average of the two directional scores. In this workflow, this dataset captures the model’s per-example outputs for downstream evaluation, inspection of mistakes, and construction of the overall summary metrics.

Subset of error cases from the GLUE MRPC validation run using the textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC model. Each record captures one misclassified sentence pair and includes the fields: idx (validation-set position), sentence1, sentence2, true (ground-truth binary label), and pred (model-predicted binary label). This dataset is created by selecting the first 10 examples where the model prediction differs from the true label, and each record is linked back to the corresponding source example in glue_mrpc_validation and its entry in mrpc_distilbert_predictions. Its role in the workflow is error analysis: it provides a compact, inspectable sample of model failures for diagnosing paraphrase detection mistakes.

This dataset contains the final evaluation summary for the textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC model on the GLUE MRPC validation split. It is a small output table with one record summarizing model performance over the full validation dataset.

Fields:
- accuracy: overall classification accuracy on the validation set
- f1: F1 score for the paraphrase classification task
- classification_report: full text report from sklearn including precision, recall, F1, and support for the not_paraphrase and paraphrase classes

In this workflow, this dataset serves as the final results artifact. It is created after running batched inference on sentence pairs, comparing predictions against ground-truth labels, and aggregating the metrics. The record is linked to the full validation input dataset and the prediction dataset so a user can trace the reported metrics back to the underlying examples and model outputs.

Per-example prediction dataset for the GLUE MRPC validation split. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores the model output from this notebook’s similarity-based paraphrase detection pipeline using distilbert-base-uncased embeddings. The fields are: prediction (binary label, 1 if the cosine similarity between the two sentence embeddings is at least 0.85, otherwise 0) and cosine_scores (the raw cosine similarity score as a float). The embeddings are produced by mean-pooling DistilBERT token representations while excluding special tokens such as [CLS] and [SEP], followed by L2 normalization. In this workflow, this dataset serves as the detailed per-row inference output that links back to the original MRPC validation examples and is then used to compute and document overall evaluation metrics in the summary dataset.

pipeline_distilbert_shortened is a derived prediction dataset created from the glue_mrpc_validation split by running the Hugging Face text-classification pipeline with the model textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC on sentence pairs truncated to a maximum length of 64 tokens. It contains one record per input example and stores the model’s inference outputs in two fields: prediction, the predicted class as an integer label ID, and score, the softmax confidence score associated with the predicted label. Each record is linked back to the corresponding row in glue_mrpc_validation, so this dataset serves as the per-example model output table used for downstream evaluation, error analysis, and summary metric generation in this workflow.

Per-example inference outputs for the GLUE MRPC validation set produced by the Hugging Face text-classification pipeline using textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC. Each record corresponds to one input sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores the model’s predicted class and the softmax probability of the positive/paraphrase class. The dataset is structured as one row per validation example with fields for prediction (integer class label from argmax) and the positive-class probability (intended as positive_probs; in the appended records this is written as paraphrase_probs). In this workflow, this dataset serves as the main prediction artifact linking model outputs back to the source validation examples and is used downstream to compute accuracy, F1, and the classification report summary.

Per-example inference results from the Hugging Face model textattack/distilbert-base-uncased-MRPC run on the glue_mrpc_validation dataset. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from the MRPC validation split and stores two fields: prediction, a binary label produced by thresholding the model’s paraphrase probability at 0.70; and paraphrase_probs, the softmax probability assigned to the positive paraphrase class. Records are linked back to the matching input example in glue_mrpc_validation. This dataset serves as the main prediction output of the workflow and is used for downstream evaluation, error analysis, and creation of the run-level summary dataset.

This dataset stores the evaluation summary for the notebook run that applies the cross-encoder/quora-distilroberta-base model to the GLUE MRPC validation set after text normalization. It contains a single aggregated record rather than per-example predictions. The fields are: accuracy (float), f1 (float), and classification_report (string with the full sklearn classification report for the not_paraphrase/paraphrase labels). Its role in the workflow is to capture experiment-level performance metrics derived from comparing the normalized-text predictions in distilbert-normalized-text-prediction against the ground-truth labels in glue_mrpc_validation, providing a compact summary of model performance for this run.

Per-example prediction dataset for the GLUE MRPC validation split generated by a DistilBERT sentence-similarity baseline. Each record corresponds to one sentence pair from glue_mrpc_validation and stores two fields: prediction, a binary label produced by thresholding cosine similarity between the mean-pooled DistilBERT embeddings of sentence1 and sentence2; and cosine_scores, the raw cosine similarity value for that pair. The threshold is the median cosine similarity over the full validation set. In this workflow, this dataset is the intermediate output used to inspect pairwise similarity predictions and to support downstream evaluation and summary metrics.
